description: ChatBI 执行准确率评测集：120 题，覆盖 6 个语义主题、时间口径、分组、TopN、多指标与澄清。

questions.question: 今年销售额是多少
questions.goldenSql: SELECT SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE status = 'COMPLETED') AS sales_amount FROM v_sales_fact WHERE (order_date >= date_trunc('year', CURRENT_DATE))

questions.goldenSql: SELECT SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE status = 'COMPLETED') AS sales_amount FROM v_sales_fact WHERE (order_date >= date_trunc('year', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1 year' AND order_date < date_trunc('year', CURRENT_DATE))

questions.question: 销售额和维修成本分别是多少
今年销售额和订单数
questions.goldenSql: SELECT SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE status = 'COMPLETED') AS sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FILTER (WHERE status = 'COMPLETED') AS order_count FROM v_sales_fact WHERE (order_date >= date_trunc('year', CURRENT_DATE))

questions.question: 今年销售额和毛利
questions.goldenSql: SELECT SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE status = 'COMPLETED') AS sales_amount, SUM(gross_profit) FILTER (WHERE status = 'COMPLETED') AS gross_profit FROM v_sales_fact WHERE (order_date >= date_trunc('year', CURRENT_DATE))

questions.question: 今年各区域销售额和订单数
questions.goldenSql: SELECT region, SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE status = 'COMPLETED') AS sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FILTER (WHERE status = 'COMPLETED') AS order_count FROM v_sales_fact WHERE (order_date >= date_trunc('year', CURRENT_DATE)) GROUP BY region

questions.question: 今年各供应商采购金额和采购单数
questions.goldenSql: SELECT supplier_name, SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'CANCELLED') AS purchase_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT po_id) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'CANCELLED') AS purchase_order_count FROM v_purchase_fact WHERE (order_date >= date_trunc('year', CURRENT_DATE)) GROUP BY supplier_name

questions.question: 今年各仓库库存量和库存金额
questions.goldenSql: SELECT warehouse_name, SUM(quantity) AS inventory_quantity, ROUND(SUM(inventory_value), 2) AS inventory_value FROM v_inventory_snapshot GROUP BY warehouse_name
